data.name: Dix
data.gender_notes: Dix is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'dikaios' meaning 'just, righteous, or lawful'. In Christian context, it symbolizes God's justice, fairness, and righteousness. The name Dix carries the meaning “God's justice” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Dix usually hope their child will grow to embody god's justice and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Carrying the spirit of justice and righteousness
data.etymology: Dix belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's justice.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dix total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
